title: 有马加奈 · B小町舞台的定格
description: 【演出舞台·聚光灯下】加奈穿着红白打歌服，握住麦克风完成歌曲结尾的定格。红色短发下的额角泛着汗光，她目光明亮而专注，背景收进暗色舞台，只留下追光照亮层叠裙摆。
action: 握着麦克风完成歌曲结尾定格，红瞳专注而额角带汗。
promptProse: At the center of a concert stage, Kana grips her microphone and lands the final pose of a song. A bead of sweat shines at her temple beneath wine-red bangs, while her red-and-white layered costume catches a single brilliant spotlight. Her ruby eyes burn with practiced concentration; the medium stage portrait gives the frame to her alone, with dark theatrical space behind the light.

title: 有马加奈 · 排练室镜子前的独白
description: 空排练室，她对着整墙镜子反复练习同一个转身，地板上是贴着标记的胶带；休息时直接坐在地板上喝水，看着镜中的自己，表情在不甘与鼓劲之间切换。
action: 坐在地板标记旁喝水，看着镜中自己重新鼓劲。
promptProse: After repeating a turn in the empty rehearsal studio, Kana sits on the floor beside taped position marks and drinks from a water bottle. Her red bob rests against the charcoal T-shirt as she studies her reflection in the wall mirror. Frustration and self-encouragement share her expression; broad studio lighting shows the practice shoes, floor tape and unglamorous work behind the performance.

title: 有马加奈 · 剧本围读的荧光笔
description: 事务所会议室，她面前摊着画满荧光笔与便签的剧本，手指抵着下巴默读台词；周围人还没进入状态，她已经完全沉浸在角色里——努力家的素颜。
action: 手指抵着下巴默读剧本，帽子放在荧光笔与便签旁。
promptProse: Before the others arrive at the agency meeting room, Kana silently studies a script crowded with highlighter marks and small page flags. A fingertip rests beneath her chin, ruby eyes following the next line. Her beret sits beside the notebook rather than on her head; a cream cardigan and soft overhead light frame this absorbed table portrait, with the marked pages clearly present but unreadable.

title: 有马加奈 · 10 秒落泪的现场
description: 拍摄现场，导演喊开始后她低头调整呼吸，再抬头时眼泪已经精准挂在眼眶里；画面捕捉情绪到位的一瞬间，是她职业能力的最高光。
action: 调整一次呼吸后抬头，将泪水准确凝在眼眶里。
promptProse: A single continuous close view of Kana Arima on a film set, cropped from the shoulders upward. Her head has just lifted after a steady breath; one tear gathers on the lower rim of each ruby eye, her mouth closed in controlled sadness. Wine-red blunt bangs and the white collar of her school blouse remain visible. A softly blurred studio lamp glows behind her left shoulder. Only one face appears, filling most of the unbroken canvas.

title: 有马加奈 · 便利店深夜的庆功
description: 结束工作后独自走进便利店，她把炸鸡、甜点和新出的心情饮料堆满购物篮，在停车场边吃着东西看手机里自己的演出评论；看到好评时装作不在意，嘴角却压不住。
action: 一边吃收工奖励，一边用手机看演出评论并忍住笑意。
promptProse: Kana sits on a low rail beside a convenience store at night, reading the smartphone held upright in her right hand. The small rectangular phone has a glossy black back and camera lens. Her left hand holds a piece of fried chicken above a paper bag; a sealed dessert cup and soft-drink bottle rest beside her. Her burgundy beret and cream cardigan catch the shop light as a pleased smile slips past her attempt at indifference.

title: 有马加奈 · 贝雷帽店的挑选
description: 帽饰店，她踮着脚取下货架上不同颜色的贝雷帽在镜前比对，表情是面对专业装备般的严肃；「帽皇」的人设在这一幕以生活化方式落地。
action: 踮脚取下贝雷帽，认真对比不同颜色。
promptProse: Inside a hat shop, Kana rises on her toes to lift a beret from a high shelf, comparing its color against another held near the mirror. Her expression is as serious as if choosing professional equipment. A cream cardigan sleeve stretches with the raised arm; warm shop lighting separates red, blue and ivory hats around her focused reflection in a three-quarter portrait.

title: 有马加奈 · 后台卸妆后的空白
description: 演出结束的后台，她坐在化妆镜前拆掉发饰、卸掉舞台妆，镜子里是没有偶像光环的素脸；疲惫与满足混在一起，是舞台人真实的收工表情。
action: 换好排练便装后卸下妆容，坐在镜前露出疲惫而满足的神情。
promptProse: Backstage after changing into practice clothes, Kana sits at the dressing mirror with her stage hair ornaments laid out beside a cleansing pad. The makeup is gone, leaving tired but satisfied ruby eyes and a small natural smile. Round mirror bulbs warm her red bob and charcoal T-shirt; the seated portrait includes the quiet dressing table and closed costume bag.

title: 有马加奈 · 试镜等候室的紧张
description: 试镜等候室，她抱着号码牌坐在长椅上，表面闭目养神，膝盖上的剧本边角却被捏出折痕；天才的自尊与害怕落选的恐惧在此同框。
action: 闭眼端坐抱着号码牌，手指把膝上剧本边角捏出折痕。
promptProse: In a quiet audition waiting room, Kana sits straight on a blue bench with both eyes fully closed. Her lips press into a restrained anxious line beneath wine-red bangs. A small number card lies on top of the script on her knees, and one hand visibly pinches a wrinkled page corner. The burgundy beret and cream cardigan are carefully arranged. Cool ceiling light reveals the tense fingers in a single seated view from head to knees.

title: 有马加奈 · 雨天共享雨伞的别扭
description: （恋爱喜剧向）放学后的雨，她站在屋檐下明明带了伞却磨蹭着不走，最后把伞硬塞给对方自己准备冲进雨里；满脸写着「才不是担心你」，耳根通红。
action: 红着耳根把伞递向画外，身体却做出要冲进雨里的姿势。
promptProse: Under the school rain shelter, Kana extends her right arm straight forward with a folded blue umbrella gripped firmly by its curved handle. The folded canopy points downward, entirely visible between her hand and knees. Her left hand keeps her schoolbag at her side. Ruby eyes glance aside, lips pursed, ears pink beneath the red bob. Grey rainy daylight fills this single scene of a reluctant but considerate offer.

title: 有马加奈 · 祭典捞金鱼的胜负欲
description: 夏祭摊位，她挽起袖子全神贯注捞金鱼，浴衣袖摆滑下也顾不上；捞到之后高高举起战利品，虎牙都笑出来的瞬间，比舞台笑容更真实。
action: 举起装着金鱼的小袋开怀大笑，另一手仍拿着纸网。
promptProse: Kana lifts a small goldfish bag triumphantly above the festival pool, laughing so openly that her tiny canine tooth shows. Her red-and-white yukata sleeves are gathered safely clear of the water, one hand still holding the paper scoop. Warm lantern light ripples over the pool and her delighted ruby eyes in a close, lively portrait of winning an ordinary summer game.

title: 早坂爱 · 清晨四宫宅的女仆晨检
description: 【四宫宅走廊·清晨】早坂爱穿着整洁的黑白女仆装停在高窗旁，双手稳稳持着平板核对日程。侧马尾落在肩后，表情克制而专注；晨光在木地板上排成长条，远处走廊仍然安静。
action: 停在高窗边，双手持平板低头核对日程。
promptProse: Ai Hayasaka pauses beside a high window in the quiet Shinomiya corridor. Both hands support a schedule tablet at chest level; her blue eyes look down at its screen rather than toward the viewer. Her blonde side ponytail and white maid headband sit neatly above a long-sleeved black dress and white apron. Narrow morning light crosses the wooden floor behind her. Frame her face and tablet together in a waist-up side view.

title: 早坂爱 · 放学后的辣妹切换
description: 学校空教室，她对着小镜子把制服领口松开、涂上唇膏，对着镜子练习夸张的笑容；镜里镜外两个表情，构图核心是「上戏前的一秒」。
action: 对着手镜补好唇色，练习从职业表情切换成亲切笑容。
promptProse: Alone in an empty classroom after school, Ai holds a small mirror and touches up her lip color before rehearsing an exaggerated friendly smile. Her uniform collar remains neatly covered, the side ponytail held by its scrunchie. Her reflected expression is lively while her eyes outside the mirror still look calculating; warm window light catches this instant before she adopts her school persona.

title: 早坂爱 · 任务间隙的便利店甜食
description: 深夜便利店，还穿着便装伪装的她一口气拿了三样期间限定甜点，在停车场角落靠着栏杆开吃；高压工作后的糖分补给，是她为数不多的自私时间。
action: 靠着栏杆打开限定甜点，短暂松下工作中的紧绷。
promptProse: At the edge of a late-night convenience-store car park, Ai leans against a railing with three seasonal desserts balanced in their small paper bag. She opens one cup with a relieved, quietly selfish smile after a long assignment. Her navy jacket and jeans look ordinary beneath the bright store sign; a nearby portrait contrasts soft dessert colors with the cool parking-lot shadows.

title: 早坂爱 · 广播体操的秘密特训
description: （名场面延展）清晨无人的庭院，她穿着运动服认真到近乎悲壮地反复练习广播体操动作，汗水湿透了 T 恤；表情严肃得像在备战奥运，反差感拉满。
action: 双脚站稳反复练习广播体操，双臂平伸而神情认真。
promptProse: In the empty estate garden at sunrise, Ai repeats a radio-calisthenics stretch with almost comically solemn precision. Her arms reach sideways, feet planted firmly, and sweat beads at her brow above an opaque blue athletic T-shirt. Grey tracksuit trousers follow the grounded stance. Garden stones and dew sparkle behind her determined face in a medium full view of the exercise.

title: 早坂爱 · 天台上的情报汇报
description: 学校天台背风角落，她压低声音对着蓝牙耳机简短汇报，目光扫视楼下中庭；通话结束后瞬间切回慵懒辣妹姿态，一个画面两层人格。
action: 按住无线耳机低声汇报，蓝眼睛扫过楼下中庭。
promptProse: Sheltered from the wind on the school rooftop, Ai touches a small wireless earpiece and delivers a brief report while watching the courtyard below. Her blue eyes stay sharp above a tidy school collar; one shoulder relaxes as the call ends. A close three-quarter angle includes the rooftop wall and distant school windows, making the transition from alert professional to casual student visible.

title: 早坂爱 · 美发沙龙的决断
description: （辞职篇）美发沙龙，她看着镜中长发被一缕缕剪短落地，手指在膝上微微收紧又松开；镜中表情从紧绷到如释重负，是角色弧线最重的一幕。
action: 看着镜中剪短的头发，膝上的手指慢慢松开。
promptProse: At the salon, Ai studies her newly shortened blonde hair in the mirror. A light salon cape covers her travel jacket, cut strands lie on the floor, and fingers on her lap slowly unclench. The reflected blue eyes shift from tension to relief. Soft neutral salon lighting and the chair back frame the quiet decision in a seated medium portrait, with no second person visible.

title: 早坂爱 · 雨天采购的狼狈专业户
description: 超市停车场大雨，她推着塞满生活用品的购物车小跑，纸袋抱在怀里护住，肩膀湿透半边；就算狼狈也先把买的东西安顿好，女仆本能深入骨髓。
action: 护着怀里的纸袋推购物车前行，先稳住满车日用品。
promptProse: Ai hurries through an empty supermarket car park under heavy rain. Her left arm presses a brown paper grocery bag against her opaque navy jacket, while her right hand pushes a trolley loaded with vegetables and boxed household supplies. Wet hair strands cling beside her focused blue eyes; the side ponytail swings behind her. Close horizontal framing keeps her and the trolley large against plain wet asphalt and blurred store lighting.

title: 早坂爱 · 卡拉 OK 包厢的演技练习
description: 一个人订了小包厢，她对着屏幕练习辣妹腔与流行歌曲，唱到一半自己先垮下脸吐槽；包厢霓虹灯光下的独处，是千层饼少有的缝隙。
action: 唱到一半放低麦克风，垮下肩膀对屏幕露出无奈。
promptProse: Ai sits alone on the karaoke sofa with the microphone lowered to her lap, well away from her mouth. Her shoulders sag, blue eyes half closed and lips pulled into a small exasperated frown. A navy jacket and jeans replace her work uniform, while the blonde side ponytail stays tied. Blue neon falls across the unused microphone and a remote control on the table, capturing the pause when she stops rehearsing a cheerful voice.

title: 早坂爱 · 旅行前的行李整理
description: （辞职后）公寓房间，短发形态的她把护照和地图放进行李箱，犹豫了一下又把旧女仆装的照片收进夹层；动作平静，但每一件物品都带着告别的重量。
action: 短发形态跪坐整理护照与地图，把旧照片收入夹层。
promptProse: Short-haired Ai kneels beside an open suitcase in her apartment, placing a passport and folded map between neatly packed clothes. She pauses over an old photograph of her maid uniform before slipping it into an inner pocket. Her blue jacket sleeves rest against the case; gentle afternoon light reveals the practical preparations and restrained emotion of choosing a journey for herself.

title: 早坂爱 · 深夜阳台的黑咖啡
description: 四宫宅佣人区的窄阳台，结束一天工作的她靠着栏杆喝黑咖啡，发圈已经取下、头发散着；望着宅邸灯火，脸上是只属于凌晨一点的、没有观众的疲惫。
action: 散着头发靠栏杆喝黑咖啡，望向宅邸灯光放松下来。
promptProse: Loose blonde hair falls over Ai’s cream cardigan as she rests her forearms on a narrow balcony rail. Both hands cradle a ceramic cup of black coffee, her blue eyes lowered with the quiet fatigue of a late shift. A scrunchie rests beside the cup. Close framing fills the canvas with her face, hands and the wooden rail; the mansion windows shine softly behind her in the night air, with no border or inset.

title: 椎名真白 · 画室中央的新作
description: 樱花庄 202 室，她赤脚站在比人还高的画布前，白衬衫下摆沾满颜料，手里横握着画笔；回头看向门口时脸上毫无表情，发丝上还沾着一点钴蓝。
action: 手持画笔，站在大画布前回头看向门口。
promptProse: Mashiro stands beside a tall canvas in her paint-marked white shirt and navy trousers. Her right hand holds one plain wooden paintbrush near its ferrule; the single blue bristle tip touches a small blue stroke on the canvas, while the dry wooden handle extends backward from her hand. She looks back toward the doorway with calm pale orange eyes. Afternoon light crosses her long cream-blonde hair, the canvas grain and neatly placed paint tubes.

title: 椎名真白 · 年轮蛋糕的仪式感
description: 矮桌前，她把年轮蛋糕端端正正摆在盘子中央，双手扶膝盯着它看了足足十秒才下叉；咬下第一口时眼睛几不可察地弯了一下，是她最大的表情幅度。
action: 跪坐在矮桌前，双手扶膝认真端详年轮蛋糕。
promptProse: Kneeling at a low table, Mashiro studies a neatly centered slice of baumkuchen with both hands resting on her knees. A small fork waits beside the plate; her orange eyes soften almost imperceptibly at the prospect of the first bite. Her cream sweater and loose trousers fold naturally at the knees, with quiet afternoon light crossing the tatami and ceramic plate.

title: 椎名真白 · 通宵原稿的清晨
description: 立志漫画家的时期。桌上摊着画了一整夜的漫画原稿和歪倒的笔，她趴在稿纸之间睡着了，晨光落在散开的长发与未干的墨线上。
action: 将脸枕在手臂上，伏在通宵绘制的稿纸间睡去。
promptProse: Mashiro is deeply asleep at her manga desk, both eyes completely closed and her cheek resting on folded forearms. Long cream-blonde hair spreads across unfinished manuscript pages beside capped pens and a small ink bottle. Her paint-marked white shirt stays buttoned above navy trousers. A close horizontal view fills the picture with the sleeping face, arms and papers while soft dawn light enters from the left, with an unbroken full-canvas composition.

title: 椎名真白 · 便利店甜点柜前
description: 她贴在便利店甜点柜玻璃前，视线锁定年轮蛋糕，手指在玻璃上留下小小的雾气；被问「要买吗」时只是持续点头，动作像等待投喂的猫。
action: 指尖轻触玻璃，专注看着柜中的年轮蛋糕。
promptProse: At a convenience-store dessert cabinet, Mashiro fixes her orange eyes on a wrapped baumkuchen. A fingertip touches a faint patch of mist on the glass while she gives a tiny determined nod. Her red school ribbon and navy blazer remain tidy against the chilled display; the close three-quarter view catches the cake reflection and her patient, catlike concentration.

title: 椎名真白 · 美术室夕阳下的素描
description: 学校美术室，她坐在高脚凳上为摆动的石膏像起稿，夕阳把她的侧脸与画板染成同色系；周围同学的喧闹完全进不了她的世界。
action: 坐在高脚凳上观察石膏像，用铅笔起稿。
promptProse: Seated on a tall stool in the school art room, Mashiro draws a graphite outline on the white paper clipped to the drawing board on her lap. The pencil tip visibly touches the sketch. A plaster bust stands on a separate pedestal beyond the board, the object she is observing. Golden sunset warms her cream-blonde hair, orange eyes and navy school blazer. A three-quarter seated view clearly separates the drawing paper from the sculpture.

title: 椎名真白 · 雨中撑伞的猫步
description: 放学小雨，她撑着伞沿着白线一步一步走猫步，积水溅起也不管；伞沿压得很低，只露出没有表情的半张脸，画面安静而奇妙。
action: 压低雨伞，沿白线一步接一步地轻巧前行。
promptProse: Under a low-held umbrella after school, Mashiro follows the white road marking with one careful step placed directly ahead of the other. A small splash rises beside her school shoes, unnoticed. Only the lower edge of her calm face peeks beneath the umbrella, with pale hair falling over her blazer; a nearby street-level view holds the rain, road line and quiet movement.

title: 椎名真白 · 晾被单的天台
description: 她抱着湿被单爬上樱花庄天台，被单被风吹得鼓起来把她整个人裹住一半；从白布后面探出头来的瞬间，像一只从茧里钻出来的动物。
action: 握住被单两角迎风晾起，从鼓起的白布后探出头。
promptProse: On Sakurasou rooftop, a gust catches the damp bedsheet Mashiro is lifting toward the laundry line. The opaque white cloth billows around one shoulder as she peeks over its edge, still holding both corners. Her paint-stained shirt and navy trousers anchor the everyday chore; blue sky, clothespins and sunlit fabric surround her mildly puzzled orange eyes.

title: 椎名真白 · 文化节壁画的脚手架上
description: 文化节大型壁画作业，她坐在临时脚手架边缘指挥全局，双腿悬空，手里颜料盘五颜六色；这是她极少数「融入集体」却依然我行我素的时刻。
action: 坐在低脚手架上，持调色盘并用画笔指向未完成的壁画。
promptProse: Mashiro sits on a low, secure scaffold platform beside a school-festival mural, feet dangling above the floor and a multicolored palette balanced in her hand. She points her brush toward an unfinished section with complete artistic certainty. Paint spots cover her work shirt and trousers; the horizontal composition includes her focused face, bright mural and stacked brushes in afternoon light.

title: 椎名真白 · 空太睡颜的速写
description: 她盘腿坐在旁边，用速写本画睡着的人的侧脸，神情专注得像在面对世界级名画；画完后认真端详，第一次对自己的「不懂」产生了疑问。
action: 盘腿坐着描画睡颜素描，停笔端详纸上的侧脸。
promptProse: Cross-legged beside the sofa, Mashiro carefully sketches a sleeping friend whose face appears only as a pencil drawing on her open sketchbook. She studies the completed profile with a faintly questioning gaze, pencil resting against her cheek. Her cream sweater sleeves bunch at the wrists; a quiet lamplit composition centers her concentration, the drawing and soft living-room cushions.

title: 椎名真白 · 毕业展的白色展厅
description: 个人画展的白色展厅，她穿着干净的连衣裙站在自己的巨幅画作前，双手背在身后；面对观众依旧是三无表情，但手指在背后悄悄握紧。
action: 在巨幅画作前转头，双手藏在背后轻轻握紧。
promptProse: A huge painting hangs behind Mashiro in the white graduation-exhibition gallery. She turns slightly toward visitors outside the frame, fingers quietly clasped behind her ivory dress although her expression stays composed. Her pale orange eyes carry restrained anticipation. Soft gallery lighting separates cream-blonde hair from the white wall, leaving generous headroom in the medium portrait.

title: 和泉纱雾 · 被炉绘图舱
description: 她的房间中央，被炉上架着绘图板与显示器，她整个人缩在被炉里只露出脑袋和拿笔的手，耳机夹着碎发；屏幕上是从未示人的新插画，房间灯光全关只剩屏幕光。
action: 缩在被炉中，戴着耳机用数位笔绘制新插画。
promptProse: Inside her dark bedroom, Sagiri works from a warm kotatsu almost entirely hidden by its quilt, only her head and drawing hand visible. Loose silver strands catch under her headset as the stylus follows a new landscape illustration on the tablet. Monitor light illuminates her concentrated blue eyes, with brushes and cables arranged across the low tabletop in a close horizontal view.

title: 和泉纱雾 · 直播中的另一张脸
